request.query: composition of algebra evaluation homomorphisms in multivariate polynomial free commutative algebra

items.name: MvPolynomial.comp_aeval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (f : σ → S₁) {B : Type u_2} [inst_3 : CommSemiring B] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (φ : S₁ →ₐ[R] B),
  φ.comp (MvPolynomial.aeval f) = MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => φ (f i)

items.name: MvPolynomial.comp_eval₂Hom
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {S₂ : Type w} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring S₂] (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁) (φ : S₁ →+* S₂),
  φ.comp (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g) = MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (φ.comp f) fun i => φ (g i)

items.name: MvPolynomial.map_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {S₂ : Type w} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁]
  (f : R →+* S₁) [inst_2 : CommSemiring S₂] (g : S₁ →+* S₂) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.map g) ((MvPolynomial.map f) p) = (MvPolynomial.map (g.comp f)) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (f : σ → S₁) {B : Type u_2} [inst_3 : CommSemiring B] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (φ : S₁ →ₐ[R] B) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  φ ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) p) = (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => φ (f i)) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eval₂
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} {τ : Type u_3} {x : τ → S}
  [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* MvPolynomial τ S) (g : σ → MvPolynomial τ S) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval x) (MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g p) =
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ ((MvPolynomial.eval x).comp f) (fun s => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (g s)) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (g : σ → R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), f ((MvPolynomial.eval g) p) = MvPolynomial.eval₂ f (⇑f ∘ g) p

items.name: Polynomial.aeval_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p q : Polynomial R} {A : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  (x : A), (Polynomial.aeval x) (p.comp q) = (Polynomial.aeval ((Polynomial.aeval x) q)) p
